message.content:
The spec update succeeded (part2 ok, grep confirms FR-014+ content present). Now updating the checklist and HANDOFF.

{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p = 'specs/001-transactions/checklists/requirements.md'
s = open(p).read()
old = '''- [x] No [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers remain (0 found; resolved via
  Assumptions A1-A8)
- [x] Requirements are testable and unambiguous (FR-001..FR-013 each state a
  concrete observable behavior)
- [x] Success criteria are measurable (SC-001..SC-005)
- [x] Success criteria are technology-agnostic (no implementation details)
- [x] All acceptance scenarios are defined (14 Given/When/Then scenarios)
- [x] Edge cases are identified (8 edge cases)
- [x] Scope is clearly bounded (additive module; A6, A7)
- [x] Dependencies and assumptions identified (A1-A8; existing LRUCache)'''
new = '''- [x] No [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers remain (0 found; resolved via
  Assumptions A1-A11)
- [x] Requirements are testable and unambiguous (FR-001..FR-021 each state a
  concrete observable behavior)
- [x] Success criteria are measurable (SC-001..SC-008)
- [x] Success criteria are technology-agnostic (no implementation details)
- [x] All acceptance scenarios are defined (23 Given/When/Then scenarios)
- [x] Edge cases are identified (15 edge cases)
- [x] Scope is clearly bounded (additive module; A6, A7)
- [x] Dependencies and assumptions identified (A1-A11; existing LRUCache)'''
assert old in s, 'checklist block not found'
s = s.replace(old, new, 1)
old2 = '''- [x] User scenarios cover primary flows (P1 store/retrieve, P2 invalidate/LRU,
  P3 config/replacement safety)'''
new2 = '''- [x] User scenarios cover primary flows (P1 store/retrieve, P2 invalidate/LRU,
  P2 multi-tag/resize/lazy-tags, P3 config/replacement safety)'''
assert old2 in s
s = s.replace(old2, new2, 1)
old3 = '''## Notes

- All items pass; no spec updates required before `$speckit-plan`.
- Traceability: FR-001..FR-013 map to milestone requirements R01 (FR-002..004),
  R02 (FR-005..FR-009), R02 extension/Claim-A (FR-010), R03 (FR-001, FR-011,
  FR-012), and API preservation (FR-013).'''
new3 = '''## Notes

- All items pass; no spec updates required before `$speckit-plan`.
- Updated 2026-10-17 for milestone 2 (R04-R06) and Claim-A round-2 R05
  clarification: added User Story 4, FR-014..FR-021, SC-006..SC-008, A9-A11,
  and the Requirement Traceability table.
- The conflicting old design note ('empty all-tags matches every key and
  resizing may flush the cache') is superseded by R04/R05 (see A9) and is
  explicitly NOT relied upon.
- Traceability: FR-001..FR-021 map to R01 (FR-002..004), R02
  (FR-005..FR-009), R02 extension/Claim-A (FR-010), R03 (FR-001, FR-011,
  FR-012), API preservation (FR-013), R04 (FR-014..FR-016), R05
  (FR-017, FR-018), R05 clarification round 2 (FR-019), and R06
  (FR-020, FR-021).'''
assert old3 in s
s = s.replace(old3, new3, 1)
open(p, 'w').write(s)
print('checklist ok')
PYEOF"}
